subject: Follow-up: Demo recap + procurement & billing next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Hartman <susan.hartman@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Demo recap + procurement & billing next steps

Hi Susan / Procurement team —

Thanks again for taking time to join the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the procurement and billing side: 

Recap
- Demo covered latency/cost profiles for your batch embedding workload and multi-tenant isolation on Dedicated capacity.
- We noted interest in both AWS Marketplace (for faster procurement) and a direct reserved contract (for more favorable unit economics).

Procurement & billing questions we discussed (please confirm the items below):
1) Commercial path: Do you prefer to proceed via a PO (submit to our finance team) or via card/marketplace purchase? You mentioned your legal team prefers PO for first-time vendors.
2) Net terms: What net terms does Acme require (Net 30, Net 45, etc.)?
3) Invoice requirements: Legal name, billing address, tax/VAT ID (if applicable), PO reference format, and whether an electronic invoice (PDF) is acceptable or you require a particular EDI format.
4) Contact for billing: Please confirm the exact finance contact and invoice email (e.g., finance@acme-analytics.com).

Attachments: I attached the proposal we walked through and our standard SOW template. If you can attach your PO intake template (or W-9 / vendor form) that would help speed the internal review.

Proposed next steps
- If you prefer PO: we can send a quote + invoice-ready PDF and the SOW for signature (DocuSign link) so your procurement team can issue a PO.
- If Marketplace: we'll provide the marketplace offer details and expected billing cadence (note: marketplace purchases often change billing flow and may add a marketplace fee).

I'll loop in Dylan and Evelyn to help with pricing specifics and to ensure the invoice format matches your finance requirements.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with your procurement/finance folks if helpful.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0183

Attachments: Redwood-Proposal-Acme-20260627.pdf, SOW-template.docx

From: Susan Hartman <susan.hartman@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Analytics Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Demo recap + procurement & billing next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the detailed recap — super helpful. A few answers from procurement/finance: 

1) Commercial path: Acme prefers a PO for first-time vendors. We will need a quote/invoice that includes our PO number once issued.
2) Net terms: Our standard is Net 45 for new vendors; finance may approve Net 30 after first renewal.
3) Invoice requirements: Please send invoices to finance@acme-analytics.com. Invoices must include: legal name (Acme Analytics, Inc.), billing address (Acme Analytics, Inc., 120 Harbor Drive, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110), and our VAT/GST ID (US: EIN 12-3456789). PDF invoices are fine.
4) PO reference: Please leave a field for PO number and the project reference ("Pilot-Redwood").

I've attached our PO intake template and vendor setup form (Acme-PO-Template.xlsx). Procurement will aim to issue a PO within ~10 business days after they receive the signed quote and vendor form.

On marketplace: procurement prefers direct PO for now to keep procurement records consistent, but if Redwood can show a faster path to onboarding via AWS Marketplace and provide a clear breakdown of any marketplace fees, we can consider that as an alternative.

Happy to set up a short call between procurement and your finance lead if needed.

Best,
Susan Hartman
Director of Procurement | Acme Analytics
susan.hartman@acme-analytics.com

Attachments: Acme-PO-Template.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Hartman <susan.hartman@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-27T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Demo recap + procurement & billing next steps

Thanks Susan — this is perfect, and very clear. Quick confirmations and actions from our side: 

- We can support PO-based billing and issue PDF invoices to finance@acme-analytics.com.
- Net 45 is acceptable for initial contract; we can revisit Net 30 on renewal as discussed.
- We'll include the legal name and billing address exactly as you supplied, and leave a field for the PO number and project reference (Pilot-Redwood).
- Redwood requires a signed quote (we'll prepare a quote/statement of work) to set up the vendor account and generate the initial invoice.

Next steps (what we'll do this week):
1) I'll upload a signed quote + SOW template and send a DocuSign link for signature.
2) Evelyn — can you confirm the invoice template we will use and whether we need to include any additional vendor fields for Acme (tax fields / EIN)?
3) Dylan — can you confirm the final pricing summary and whether we should include a marketplace pricing appendix (if Acme wants that option)?

Susan — once I have the signed quote, I'll send the invoice-ready PDF to finance@acme-analytics.com and share the DocuSign link and HubSpot deal link.

If helpful, we can also propose a short procurement/finance sync later this week to confirm the PO routing.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: Redwood-Proposal-Acme-20260627.pdf, SOW-template.docx

Subject: Internal: Acme pricing & invoice prep

Marissa / Evelyn —

Quick internal note after Susan's responses: 
- Confirmed pricing: Pilot (3 months) at $24,000/month; committed Dedicated rate thereafter per attached proposal.
- Marketplace appendix: adding marketplace option will add an ~10% fee and change billing cadence (monthly through marketplace). If the customer prefers procurement speed, we can offer marketplace as an alternative, but must flag the fee and that Redwood billing reconciliation will be different.
- Evelyn: I suggest we prepare an invoice template that includes: Redwood legal name, Redwood EIN, invoice number, invoice date, PO number field, project reference, billing address, and VAT/EIN field. Also include an additional line item with "Marketplace fees" which we can hide if not used.

I'll attach a draft invoice PDF once you confirm the header fields.

Thanks,
Dylan

Internal only.
